---
title: "Sys.getenv() always returns text"
ref: FCT-07
categories: [Factors]
impact: incoherent
extrait: 'Sys.getenv("MISSING_VAR", unset = 1234)'
reponse: '"1234"'
attendu: "the number `1234`"
versions: "All"
source: "Slack ThinkR (2022)"
---

::: {.piege}
```{r}
Sys.getenv("MISSING_VAR", unset = 1234)

Sys.setenv(N_CORES = 4)
Sys.getenv("N_CORES") + 1

Sys.setenv(DEBUG = 1)
Sys.getenv("DEBUG") == TRUE
```
:::

## Why

To the operating system, an environment variable is a character string. `Sys.getenv()` therefore always returns text, including the `unset` fallback value, which gets converted too.

The arithmetic fails loudly, but the comparison gives no warning: `"1" == TRUE` compares the text `"1"` with the text `"TRUE"`, and returns `FALSE`.

## The remedy

Convert the value you read explicitly, with a fallback given as text.

::: {.piege}
```{r}
as.integer(Sys.getenv("N_CORES", unset = "1")) + 1
as.logical(as.integer(Sys.getenv("DEBUG", unset = "0")))
```
:::
